identificationModule.briefTitle: PARP Inhibitor With CDK4/6 Inhibitor and Endocrine Therapy in HR+/ HER2-Advanced Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: PARP Inhibitor in Combination With CDK4/6 Inhibitor and Endocrine Therapy as the First-line Therapy for HR+/ HER2-Advanced Breast Cancer

collaborators.name: First Hospital of China Medical University
First Affiliated Hospital Xi'an Jiaotong University
Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Hospital

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is a prospective, open-label, phase II clinical study for patients with HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Patients with SNF3 subtype of HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer confirmed by the Department of Pathology and Key Laboratory of Breast Cancer of Fudan University Affiliated Cancer Hospital are planned to be enrolled. The main purpose is to evaluate efficacy of PARP inhibitor in SNF3 subtype of HR+/HER2- advanced breast cancer and prepare for subsequent randomized controlled phase III clinical studies with larger sample size.

armGroups.label: Cohort 1
armGroups.description: In this cohort, a patient would receive Dalpiciclib(CDK4/6 inhibitor) combined with Fluzoparib(Parp inhibitor) and endocrine therapy.

armGroups.label: Cohort 2
armGroups.description: In this cohort, a patient would receive Dalpiciclib(CDK4/6 inhibitor) combined with endocrine therapy.
